```c
void replicate_str(char* array, const char* original) {
    char temp[strlen(original) + 1]; // Create a temporary buffer
    strcpy(temp, original); // Copy original string into the temporary buffer
    strcpy(array, temp); // Copy the content of the temporary buffer into the destination array
}
```

This implementation uses a temporary buffer to avoid potential issues with writing beyond the destination array's capacity. It also prioritizes performance by using `strcpy` for direct copying
